note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the communication and the sections of the termination clause are generic placeholders, never real contract text or notices. A ("provided for") and B ("not described") are supplied cases of equal weight (lane badges in their lane colours, ● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke, the hook and the cover of the same size and timing); the only difference is the one supplied fact at the same slot. No termination doctrine is stated: no ground or right to terminate, no notice period or time limit, no effect, no validity or sufficiency judgement, no jurisdiction, no winner and no outcome; B ends neutral (the slip rests in the tray, no conclusion). Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities and sharedFacts (the shared content is the contract plate, the sections and the communication, all editable). Stress cap (standing coordinator rule 2026-09-26, AUTHORING item 20): after trying the fallbacks (the contract plate drawn once for both walls, row and column arrangements at 1:1, a wider slip column, text down to 16.6 px), the three stress sections did not fit the 1:1 side-by-side walls at ≥ 16 px with 58 characters each; they are capped at 51–52 characters ("Section 1, first item in the clause (supplied text)"), still about twice the baseline (25). Measured in Chromium: 58 characters → rows-do-not-fit at 16.6 px in both arrangements; 51–52 characters → fits at 16.6 px (row arrangement).
